summary: Iteration 49 — STT fix partially verified. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS (POST /api/transcribe + POST /api/assistant/stt both return clean JSON for silent WAV, missing-audio 400, and garbage-bytes cases; supervisor logs contain zero occurrences of the old AttributeError 'transcribe_audio'). Root-cause fix (switching to `stt.transcribe(file=<open binary handle>, model='whisper-1', language='hi', prompt=...)`) is CORRECT and confirmed against the backend directly on localhost:8001. Frontend UX fix for immediate 'listening' state on mic press-in WORKS: within 150 ms of mousedown the 'Sun raha hoon…' red state chip + waveform + pulse ring are rendered before any await — that primary user-visible ask is fixed. Short-tap (<250ms) guard also works: mic press-and-release-in-80ms returns to idle with no processing flash and no error. HOWEVER — a REGRESSION-EQUIVALENT symptom of the original bug is still reproducible from a headless browser: the Kubernetes ingress rewrites any upstream 5xx into an HTML 'Bad gateway' page, so when the backend legitimately returns HTTPException(502) for invalid audio bytes (which the browser produces because Playwright can't grant a real mic), the frontend NowBriefCard renders 'STT 502: <!DOCTYPE html> <!--[if lt IE 7]> ...' — literally the same text the user complained about. Fix root cause was correct but the ingress-behaviour edge remains user-visible whenever any STT upstream error occurs. Recommend backend return 400 (or 200 with empty text + non-fatal error) for STT upstream errors so the ingress leaves the JSON alone, plus a defensive HTML-strip in the frontend error path. Baseline regressions (keyboard text-input Hinglish reply with real AURA-* IDs, refresh regenerates brief) still pass. No new expo/react-native issues beyond the pre-existing shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver P2 warnings flagged in iter42/47/48.

minor.issue: On STT upstream errors (invalid audio bytes, litellm BadRequestError, etc.) the endpoint raises HTTPException(502). The Kubernetes ingress rewrites any 5xx response into its own HTML 'Bad gateway' page before it reaches the browser, so a clean JSON error body is never delivered to the client. Recommended fix: raise HTTPException(400, 'Audio could not be transcribed: <short reason>') OR return `{"text": "", "error": "..."}` with 200. Either preserves JSON contract and matches the user-visible expectation stated in the review request ('never HTML'). Verified backend correctly returns JSON at localhost:8001 — issue is purely the 5xx→HTML rewrite at the ingress.

ui_bugs.issue: When transcribeAudio() throws with an HTML body (as happens when the ingress swallows the backend 502), the raw HTML is dumped verbatim into the error card. Result: user sees 'STT 502: <!DOCTYPE html> <!--[if lt IE 7]>...' — the exact string from the original bug report. Defensive fix: in the catch block of onMicPressOut / transcribeAudio, detect a leading '<' or 'html' token and replace with a friendly Hinglish message like 'STT service ne error diya — thodi der baad try karein, ya keypad se type karein.' See /app/frontend/src/components/now-brief-card.tsx onMicPressOut (~line 475+) and /app/frontend/src/utils/wingman-api.ts transcribeAudio().

action_items: BACKEND (small, one-liner): In /app/backend/server.py assistant_stt() (~line 2068), change `raise HTTPException(502, f"STT upstream error: {e}")` to `raise HTTPException(400, f"STT could not transcribe audio: {e}")` — a 400 is not rewritten by the Kubernetes ingress, so the frontend will actually receive the JSON detail and can render a clean Hinglish message. Semantically 400 is also correct because the fault is bad audio input from the client, not an upstream outage.

FRONTEND (defense-in-depth): In /app/frontend/src/components/now-brief-card.tsx onMicPressOut catch block AND/OR /app/frontend/src/utils/wingman-api.ts transcribeAudio(), sanitise the error message before setErrorMsg — if the string starts with '<' or contains '<!DOCTYPE' / 'html', replace with a fixed Hinglish fallback like 'STT service se jawab nahi mila — dobara try karein ya keypad use karein.' This prevents any future ingress/CDN error page from leaking raw HTML into the UI.

rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL ROOT CAUSE (fixed): `OpenAISpeechToText.transcribe_audio(...)` did not exist on the class. The AttributeError became HTTPException(502) which the K8s ingress rewrote into an HTML 502 page. Frontend displayed the HTML in the error card. FIX APPLIED: switched to `stt.transcribe(file=<open handle>, model='whisper-1', language='hi', prompt=...)` — this now works for real audio (verified with silent WAV → returns {"text":""}). REMAINING RISK: any OTHER upstream failure (invalid audio format from a corrupt recording, litellm rate-limit, network flake, empty blob from a headless browser) still raises HTTPException(502) which the ingress still rewrites into HTML which the frontend still displays raw. Confirmed by long-press test in headless Playwright: the exact 'STT 502: <!DOCTYPE html> <!--[if lt IE 7]>...' string reappears in the card. MITIGATION: (a) backend: raise 400 instead of 502 for user-input errors, so the ingress leaves the JSON body intact; (b) frontend: strip any leading '<' / HTML from errorMsg before rendering.
